## Expected and observed behavior

Describe what happened and what you expected.

## Reproduction

Include steps, firmware mode, board type, software versions, and anonymized
counters. A small synthetic input is preferable to personal audio.

## Evidence

Include relevant test results. Remove passwords, network addresses, device
identifiers, personal paths, and recording names. Do not attach private audio,
models trained on private audio, or complete serial logs.
